title: Equipment sanitation in the Tern Inlet Coastal investigation
description_lines: All entries are computer simulations; no physical trial or empirical observations were collected.

The simulated output columns are equipment cleaning cycle completed (recorded cycle: rinse / detergent wash); residue remaining on cleaned surface (mg; e.g. 2.91); microbial growth from surface swabs (CFU/swab; e.g. 95.17).
A separate investigation at Tern Inlet Coastal examines chocolate confectionery factory production equipment through sanitation and equipment cleaning verification.
The catalogue synopsis distinguishes the subject of the study from the organisation holding the records. File names refer to the deposited edition, and row identifiers remain local to that edition.

title: Notes on chocolate milk from Fern Hollow Coastal
description_lines: All entries are computer simulations; no physical trial or empirical observations were collected.
The simulated output columns are viable microbes in beverage samples (CFU/ml; e.g. 279.16); elapsed time until observed spoilage (days; e.g. 8.28); storage chamber temperature (degrees C; e.g. 2.54).
A separate investigation at Fern Hollow Coastal examines liquid chocolate-flavoured dairy milk beverage through refrigerated shelf-life assessment.

The depositor prepared a compact overview for readers assessing whether the files fit their intended reuse. It describes the material included here rather than making claims about other installations or every product sold under a similar name.

The archive preserves the submitted ordering and spelling. Editorial notes concern interpretation and reuse only; they do not add further experimental variables. Comparisons with another release should account for its separate sampling and reporting arrangements.
